summary: Grupo Aval Acciones y Valores S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the routine payment of interest on its Sixth Issuance of Notes in the Colombian market. The filing, dated June 30, 2026, confirms the payment was made according to the terms of the offering memorandum. There is no mention of a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or any other corporate event. The disclosure is a standard interest payment update for a foreign private issuer, which does not qualify as a special situation under the defined categories.
